description: Everything Digital Gemology measures about one gemstone: refractive index (both rays for doubly refractive stones), birefringence, dispersion, specific gravity, hardness, crystal system, critical angle, what a refractometer, polariscope and dichroscope show, its pleochroic colors and the lines and bands a hand spectroscope shows, with links to the free tools.
name: gem_properties
title: Gemstone properties
